## 📦 Project submission

- [ ] Folder `projects/<slug>/` with a valid `project.yaml` (slug matches folder name)
- [ ] The project is public, genuinely uses AIsa, and its repo contains everything (screenshots, docs, demo)
- [ ] Entering the competition? `competition: "<cycle>"` is set in the metadata

## 🧩 Skill submission

- [ ] Folder `skills/<slug>/` with valid `skill.yaml`, `SKILL.md`, and the skill code
- [ ] `SKILL.md` follows the [frontmatter spec](https://www.skillsdirectory.com/docs/skill-md-format) and the folder follows the [file structure](https://www.skillsdirectory.com/docs/skill-file-structure) (code in `scripts/`, docs in `references/`)
- [ ] Uses ≥1 AIsa endpoint beyond plain model calls, declared in `aisa_endpoints_used` and genuinely called by the code (prompt-only skills are not eligible)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` documents **every** external endpoint and requirement (API keys, accounts)
- [ ] Complies with [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/AIsa-team/aisa-community/blob/main/SECURITY.md) — no download-and-execute, no undeclared credential access, no obfuscated code, no secrets
- [ ] License declared in `skill.yaml` matches the code
- [ ] Entering the competition? `competition: "<cycle>"` is set in the metadata
